    "relevance": "Direct executive-legislative record establishing a formally authorized, time-bounded reduction in fuel excise-tax liabilities for 10–16 December 2022. It identifies the responsible finance-ministry unit, statutory and decree authority, affected fuel categories, and the policy instruments to be published. This is direct evidence of fiscal and tax policy execution and potentially relevant shock-response and distributional targeting.",
    "adjacent_context": "Read with U0002, which supplies the category-specific percentages, pesos-per-liter stimulus amounts, resulting tax quotas, complementary-stimulus amounts, effective-date provision, signature, and execution date.
